theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Industrials (+0.98%) and Technology (+0.87%) led the market today, while Energy (-1.16%) and Communication Svcs (-0.70%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.15%, defensives +0.00%, and value/cyclicals +0.08% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.40%, Dow +0.80%, Nasdaq +0.43% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.49%. The VIX fell 4.08% to 15.03, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.52% to $4,328.20, crude oil was little changed at $91.69, and bitcoin slipped 0.52% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
